title: Costco and the Value of Trust
short_teaser: Costco built loyalty through a membership model, limited product selection, strong value, and a reputation for treating customers and employees consistently.
story: Costco built loyalty through a membership model, limited product selection, strong value, and a reputation for treating customers and employees consistently. The model depends on long-term trust more than constant novelty. A business can grow by making the relationship itself part of the value. Strong businesses create value people can understand and trust. The lesson is usually found in the decisions beneath the success story. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
